limitations.text: No verifiable historical glyph image is available to show 拿’s reported relationship to 拏 or the separate form 挐. The dictionary reports that 拏 was an earlier standard graph and that 拿 later became a popular, independently standard form, but no inspectable historical glyph pixels with verified identity and provenance are shown here. The earliest graphic form of 拿 therefore remains unillustrated.
